programme.desc: 'S12/E110'. Frankie moet spring om hul troue te reël, terwyl Mike nog briljante idees by Gary soek. Lendré het 'n plan en kry 'n kans om dit uit te voer.

programme.title: Skemergrond

programme.title: Klaskamer 10

programme.title: Show'KIE

programme.title: Ander Dam Se Eende

programme.title: Wanderlus

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S11/E11'. Willem Kruger se skielike verdwyning na 'n vrolike kuiery het die hele land se aandag aangegryp. Wanneer sy voertuig later in die Vaalrivier ontdek word, is daar skielik baie meer vraagtekens as antwoorde.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S11/E12'. Om met die lewe te boet ter wille van 'n paar honderd rand se goedere is die nagmerrie wat Dokter Natheem Jacobs van Athlone se geliefdes elke dag herleef ná sy sinnelose moord vir 'n paar motorbande.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S11/E13'. Hildegard Steenkamp verduister 'n paar duisend rand by haar werk en kom daarmee weg. Na meer as 300 onwettige transaksies en byna 'n dekade se bedrog, leuens en diefstal, word sy gearresteer. Hoe het sy daarmee weggekom?

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S12/E1'. 'n Geweldadige reeksmisdadiger word skokkend genoeg op borg vrygelaat na poging tot verkragting. Ingrid Koch betaal met haar lewe wanneer sy en haar man op hulle plaas aangeval word.

programme.title: Klein Sake, Groot Drome
programme.desc: 'S4/E8'. Om saam met familie op jou reis as entrepreneur te werk, is beslis die moeite werd! Litehouse, The Perfect Deli/Padel en Twin Ventures vertel vir Armand meer van hul unieke drome.

programme.title: Ons Gesels Balans
programme.desc: 'S3/E3'. Sherlin gesels met Marciel Hopkins oor beheer en hoe 'n baba balans kan laat wankel. Ruan Winter van Vitaderm praat oor kollageen en aanvullings.

programme.title: Skree Dit Uit!
programme.desc: 'S1/E53'. Aziz shares the good news that Leyla has been found but the day quickly unfolds in ways none of them expected.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S2/E66'. Canan has moved into the house and Ziya is ecstatic, but the verdict is still out if Yaman made the right choice. Ali and the team think they have a lead on Yasemin's whereabouts.

programme.title: Maanligsprokie
programme.desc: 'S1/E96'. A bit of late-night eavesdropping leaves more than one person questioning their family ties. Mahir digs up the past while an unusual package arrives at home.

programme.title: Een Wit Leuen
programme.desc: 'S1/E80'. It is the opening of the new bakery and the name is revealed. It seems as if Nejat, Aylin and Kayra are becoming a real family.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S1/E13'. Bahar gets a telling off from Reha and is seriously down in the dumps. Uras confronts Selen, which results in a huge fight. Timur once again tries to get Bahar to quit.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E7'. Davut is disappointed about Daghan' decisions. Sengul recieves an unexpected visitor. Aydan asks Daghan for help.

programme.title: Fenix
programme.desc: 'S1/E83'. Celebi grows more vicious in his pursuit of getting Gunes back. Is there anything Hulya can do to stop him, or is he too far gone to reason with?

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: 'S3/E38'. The story follows two sisters, Pragya and Bulbul, their dreams, aspirations and their intertwined destinies as seen from the eyes of a mother.
